def transform(grid):
    """Tile the grid 3 high by 2 wide, reflecting odd tile rows vertically
    and the left-hand tile horizontally."""
    out = []
    for tile_y in range(3):
        rows = grid[::-1] if tile_y % 2 == 0 else grid
        for row in rows:
            out.append(row[::-1] + row[:])
    return out
